diff --git a/src/app.js b/src/app.js
--- a/src/app.js
+++ b/src/app.js
@@ -1 +1,9 @@
-export function uniqueBy(items,key) { return [...new Map(items.map(item=>[item[key],item])).values()] }
+export function uniqueBy(items, key) {
+  const seen = new Set()
+  return items.filter(item => {
+    const value = item[key]
+    if (seen.has(value)) return false
+    seen.add(value)
+    return true
+  })
+}
diff --git a/test/uniqueBy.test.js b/test/uniqueBy.test.js
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/uniqueBy.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import test from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+
+import { uniqueBy } from '../src/app.js'
+
+test('uniqueBy keeps the first item for each key', () => {
+  const items = [
+    { id: 1, name: 'first' },
+    { id: 2, name: 'second' },
+    { id: 1, name: 'last' }
+  ]
+
+  assert.deepEqual(uniqueBy(items, 'id'), [
+    { id: 1, name: 'first' },
+    { id: 2, name: 'second' }
+  ])
+})
